title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode1 A Big Meeting!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: Cafe
Alright, once again...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: My name is Kawanishi of Happiness Home Research, and I'll be helping you find a nice property.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
So, getting right to the matter at hand...
You're looking for a place you can base yourselves out of, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Our very own place...
The MORE MORE HOUSE...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, it would be helpful to have a place for the group to call home moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We just talked about all the trouble we've been running into booking meeting rooms...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, our new home could triple as one of those, a place for us to practice and a studio for our streams. We wouldn't have to spend as much time moving back and forth.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been so busy lately that time is really starting to come at a premium. I think it's worth considering this option.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree as well...!
After all, we can only do so much up on the school's rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, you all bring up good points.
It would be really nice to have a place that sort of doubles as our home base...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But is this plan really possible?
It's like us trying to rent our dream home!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, we can't afford a lavish palace that's right next to a major terminal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we should be able to figure something out by discussing our wants and needs, and compromising where we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
And because we've been getting steady work, we have a slightly bigger budget now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In any case, we should probably ask a realtor for further advice concerning this matter...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Since we're on a budget, I'll try to find a trustworthy agency that can still show us affordable options.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll need to stay here for a little while longer... But I'll let you all know once I've found a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see what kind of houses are available...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is so exciting...!)

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: I have documents on some potential candidates that we can look at together.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Ms. Saito also already told me about your group's needs, so we can discuss those further and see what's going to be absolutely necessary.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What we're looking for is...
A place with space for us to do our streams, practice and have meetings...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Offices that are available for lease usually come up when I enter those things in...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: However, there was also mention that you'd prefer to have a shower. That made me consider more residential places as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Not many of those kinds of offices have showers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I'm having trouble imagining what a room where we'd practice dancing and stuff would look like in a regular house.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The first property I'd like to have you all look at more or less covers that. Please tell me what you think...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! This is amazing...!
It's a plain old house, but the basement's all covered in mirrors like a dance studio!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only that, it has all these sliding doors that allow you to cover them up. And this says it's even been soundproofed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This looks incredible!
We can definitely use it as a studio for practicing and streaming.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, and on the first floor, there's a spacious living room and a nice kitchen with an island.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An island?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like the counters you see in the home ec room. That'll make it a lot easier to do cooking streams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, all we'd have to do is place the camera in the living room. Those streams would be like our own cooking program!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, what's this at the far end of the balcony...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Oh, that's an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-There's an outdoor bath...?!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: It doesn't look very big based on this floor plan... But it should still be nice for when you want a change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm staggered...
I wasn't expecting to hear about an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-Me neither...
A kitchen with an island and an outdoor bath...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Imagine living in a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work with the stream, Minori.
I decided to make you some salmon poke today to help you recharge. Let's eat our fill and do our best again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're done with your bath already, Minori?
And your hair's still wet. Let me go get the dryer. I'd rather you didn't catch a cold.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Talk about living the dream.
I'm not sure my heart would be able to handle it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's off in her own little world again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, I vote for this place!
Where do we sign?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, it even said on that one website how you should pick a place you can imagine yourself living in!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Calm down, will you?
Yes, this place does have everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we're on a budget.
Take a look at the rent...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
It costs...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It really costs this much...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Yes...
This is a five-star property that fits your group's needs to the fullest.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Now that you have this as a reference, we'll look at documents for these other properties...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: If any seem appealing to you, then I'll schedule us to go see them on a later date.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we get to see what they're actually like...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start looking at these one by one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Thank you all for your time today.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: I'll start scheduling our visit for the properties we discussed.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Also, I'll send another list of prospective candidates, so please let me know if you'd like to take a look at any of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you very much for agreeing to meet with us today!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Of course. I look forward to seeing you all again.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Browsing through all those papers was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually talking about this was pretty huge. Now we know that we prefer to have mirrors in the room where we plan on practicing, and that our stream studio doesn't have to be all that big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, we learned that we can go without a kitchen island or an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would be nice to have those things, but I'm glad we're not choosing based on added luxuries.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, we get to see these places next time! I dunno if I can wait until then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, slow down... We're getting another list of properties to look through, so this is far from over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... But... We might actually get to make the MORE MORE HOUSE a reality!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then we could have sleepovers and stuff... How can I not be excited?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But don't forget that this is business.
We're looking for a place to rent because we need one for work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Yeah, I know...
This isn't all fun and games.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it means we get to spend more time together. That makes me really happy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Choosing just one out of a big list isn't going to be easy... But we gotta pick the best place available to us to turn into the MORE MORE HOUSE!)
